parsed.reason: This is an exemplary reminder line. It's a single calm sentence that frames the day ahead ("A full evening on tap") without restating clock times, singling out any particular event, or guessing at the redacted appointment. It sounds natural and conversational—exactly what a friend managing the calendar would write. It stops after one sentence and contains no exclamation marks, advice, sympathizing judgement about busyness, or extraneous information. It does precisely what a reminder line should: add warmth and context without duplicating what the formatted event list below will display.
